Question: In \(\triangle PAT,\) \(\angle P = 36^\circ,\) \(\angle A = 56^\circ,\) and \(PA = 10.\) Points \(U\) and \(G\) lie on sides \(\overline{TP}\) and \(\overline{TA},\) respectively, so that \(PU = AG = 1.\) Let \(M\) and \(N\) be the midpoints of segments \(\overline{PA}\) and \(\overline{UG},\) respectively. What is the degree measure of the acute angle formed by lines \(MN\) and \(PA?\)
